text:
Claire (People Ops): Quick heads-up: panel guests arriving at 1pm (3 people). Catering showed up but the delivery label says 'GF platters' and the courier left them at the desk. Can someone confirm before we serve?
Front Desk (Bot): Delivery logged: 1x catering box labeled 'GF platters' for 1pm. Placed in holding locker #2. Guest badges printed: 3.
Ben: I can meet them in lobby at 12:55 and confirm dietary. Also we booked Halls A+B hybrid but only Hall A gates open. Might need overflow seating.
Zoe: If Hall A >100 and we have 130 expected, we should open Hall B. Who has the key for the divider?
Ivy: Facilities asked us to call them for the movable wall; their crew is on-site and can open it in 10 mins if we ping.
Claire (People Ops): Thanks  @Ben please check the cater label and ask if any trays contain nuts/dairy. If the label is wrong, don't serve until confirmed. @Ivy can you ping Facilities to open Hall B if needed?
Front Desk (Bot): Facilities contacted: movable wall team ETA 9 minutes. Note added: "Do not serve labeled GF without confirmation."
Ben: Talked to courier  they said the box was mislabelled but chef confirmed there's dairy in the cheese tray. Holding off. Host emailed to order separate GF boxes, but they won't arrive until 2pm.
Zoe: Ok we will keep the mislabeled box sealed. Can we put guests in the green room and offer bottled water?
Dinesh: I have bottled water and extra chairs in storage. Also can set up a small snack table with individually wrapped fruit cups (GF) until proper catering arrives.
Claire (People Ops): Great. @Front Desk assign green room to the panel from 12:55-2:15 and mark luggage storage for two rolling suitcases.
Front Desk (Bot): Green Room reserved 12:55-2:15. Luggage stored: locker #7 (2 items). Badges waiting at desk.
Ben: Guest check-in done, one guest asked about parking validation for the shuttle lot  code SHT-22 valid until 4pm. They also had a small suitcase, stored in locker.
Ivy: Facilities confirmed movable wall can open. I've asked AV to prep mics and test the hybrid link.
Zoe: AV tested and mic check good. Hall B opened at 1:10 to accommodate overflow.
Claire (People Ops): Thank you! Small follow-up: update the event notes that catering mislabeled and GF replacements arrived at 2pm. We'll bill vendor separately if needed.
Dinesh: Temporary snacks set, guests comfy, luggage labeled and locked.
Ben: Panel started on time at 1:15. Catering replacement arrived at 2pm, items verified GF and served.
Claire (People Ops): Closing thread  huge thanks to the quick responders :raised_hands:
